notes.title: Update | New Character Action
notes.content:
We're here to report on our development progress. During recent development, we discovered that the main character, Hailey could be further improved beyond her basic actions of walking, running, jumping, rolling, and climbing ladders. 🔍Therefore, our development team designed a new action for Hailey.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/cdc045aa4dab31fd4038629b8161766836477be9.gif"]

(Development Log - Non-official game quality)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/b03f0097d64dc0897e812ac7abacf5a7297137be.gif"]





When the programmer demonstrated the functionality of this action, we all agreed that it was perfectly suited to the warrior Hailey, and looked particularly cool.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/7b54bcfbcaf31c9a9b48ed0a5335540c5d4d9ad0.gif"]





The related features still require further debugging and optimization. Previously, theprogrammers had overlooked the issue of character weight, so the protagonist would not fall off walls due to gravity. ⚡This issue has now been resolved.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/a8f8dc25deac785deb2c87e7dfb48ac76638cd24.gif"]





Now, we can combine this new action with our existing double jump and sprint features to add some fun to the game. We can also look forward to the potential synergies that future new gameplay mechanics and design integrations may bring!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/ab455ef40cd0fb57312d4e7da0ea84fa27a7d90d.gif"]

(Development Log - Non-official game quality)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/0415dcfb3e54df0b40525f44a7cf75132f54edbd.gif"]







Here is the video link:

notes.title: 💫 Character Remastering Update💫
notes.content:
Today we're sharing exactly what we went through during the development of  with regards to the changes in character body proportions.🔅🌞🌙

In the early versions of the design, we expected to create a cartoon-style look. With this in mind, we designed the characters to have a five-headed proportions. The reason for this design was that we initially thought that this kind of fantasy and childlike look would make the character more suitable for a fun-filled adventure on a fantasy eco-planet.🌍🚀。

”Doesn't this look cute? 😊“（The left）
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/74f3ef13c1ef12f652a58814836909b72590b745.png

We were confident when we finished development in isolation, yet nothing was as we had envisioned. After our initial modelling was complete, it felt a little off the idea ...... We seemed to have forgotten that we were making a game with an Asian aesthetic ...... The character in front of us looks like a big-headed doll that has had its figure forced into a cartoon style.🧸👀。

So various voices appeared🗣️：

“I won't buy a game with a protagonist who looks like this ......💸”

“Running and climbing stairs looks like a physical incongruity🤸”

“These legs aren't as long as my dogs' legs when they're stretched out🐶”

……

We also showed some other peers, and sure enough they all shook their heads at the same time, and finally even the producer himself couldn't stand it. He gritted his teeth and slapped his thighs, ‘Change it! Change everything!’💥

So we began to work overtime, because the character proportion of the re-creation, but also really let the previously produced animation had to be overturned to redo. (At this point the animator remembered that period of time on the silent wipe sweat) from the beginning to design animation and production to adapt to the new body, take a look at the effect is not better it ~ ~!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/a24754fbd0626c2f52779d7bb3903cc6dd5724d5.png

Change is not easy, but change is always good.🌟

Later I asked the producer, why did you make the character that way before? The producer said, ‘One leaf will always happen to everyone's eyes, so you still have to keep looking for reference coordinates, only then can it slowly get better. I thought to myself: please pay the overtime.💰💢

Lastly, let's talk about the changes brought about by this character image：

For every 5cm increase in character leg length, the animator's hairline is moved up by 1cm.👴💨

Combat action damage value increased by 200% (Because of the longer legs, the attack range is larger.)💥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/7b5fbb9101828cac1e8ecd3a43ec97b8937e5853.gif

Data shows that for every 10cm increase in leg length, the number of game screenshot clicks increases by 17%!🔥

This change is really an unforgettable experience for our little group~ I hope you enjoy the new version of Haily, and thank you for your support along the way!🙏🎮

notes.title: [GALIX:New Horizons] Recent Work Update
notes.content:
Hi Adventurer:


"GALIX:New Horizons" has attracted widespread attention from players since its launch on Steam. The development team works tirelessly every day to develop new content.

 Previously, we released the pre-alpha trailer, and we appreciate the discussions and feedback from players. [previewyoutube=DZmDSsgO_Lc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

In future development, we will gradually optimize "GALIX:New Horizons" as follows:

Character Appearance Optimization
We will optimize the appearance of characters to better fit the game style.
Improve character clothing and details to make them more refined and unique.

Character Action Optimization
In response to feedback about the lack of smoothness in character actions in early versions, we will improve the animation effects of characters.
Enhance the continuity and naturalness of actions to improve the overall visual experience.

Enriching Game Content
We will add more storyline, tasks, and activities to enhance the depth and interest of the game.
Introduce more explorable scenes and interactive elements to enrich the gaming experience for players.


We will regularly update our development log in the future. We also hope you can provide your opinions and suggestions for "GALIX:New Horizons" in your spare time. We pay close attention to everyone's thoughts and invite you to witness our growth together. 

If you enjoy "GALIX:New Horizons," please actively leave us comments here! We hope to see more opinions and suggestions from you~
